item.title: Chick-fil-A customer pulls gun after parking lot argument in Evans
item.description: A customer at the Evans Chick-fil-A got a little too heated Wednesday, showing off his gun and threatening to send another driver “to his grave,” authorities said. The post Chick-fil-A customer pulls gun after parking lot argument in Evans appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: K-9 unit helps RCSO deputies catch suspect who hid in trash during chase
item.description: A high-speed chase through Richmond County ended with the arrest of a suspect who briefly tried to hide in a trash container before being taken into custody by deputies. item.title: Motorheadline: Tesla is not a car company
item.description: Back in the mid 1980’s my friends and I had developed an addiction. The gray box that sat atop my small TV in my bedroom had a lock on us that bordered on narcotic strength. The post Motorheadline: Tesla is not a car company appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Savannah River Tritium Enterprise sets record for tritium extractions
item.description: The Savannah River Nuclear Solutions Savannah River Tritium Enterprise completed a record 13 tritium extractions within nine months spanning fiscal years 2025 and 2026, marking the highest number of extractions ever achieved in that time frame. The post Savannah River Tritium Enterprise sets record for tritium extractions appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: A winter weather forecast for the CSRA is leading to schedule changes across local school districts and college campuses this weekend, with multiple systems canceling activities Saturday and Sunday. item.title: Grovetown man sentenced in church-related child exploitation case
item.description: A Grovetown man accused of grooming and sexually exploiting a teenage girl from his church has pleaded guilty and been sentenced to prison, according to court records. The post Grovetown man sentenced in church-related child exploitation case appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Jury convicts Frederick Grace in trailer park gunfight that killed teen
item.description: A man accused of killing a bystander in a shootout at an Augusta trailer park may spend the rest of his life in prison. The post Jury convicts Frederick Grace in trailer park gunfight that killed teen appeared first on The Augusta Press.
